review.meaning: One historical participant derivatives trading-volume snapshot. Rows are Client, DII, FII, Pro and a market TOTAL; volumes are contracts by futures/options side, not OI positions or rupee cash flows.

window.basis: Embedded source basename fao_participant_vol_08062026.csv and the peer's ISO dates agree under day-first parsing.

units.total: One side 144449420 contracts. TOTAL is already the sum of four participant classes; including it again double-counts the market.

observations: All 14 numeric column totals, all 10 per-row long/short sums, and all seven market long/short pairs reconcile exactly.
FII total long minus short is -10391 volume contracts; this is not a position, cash outflow or forecast.
The only stored zero is DII Option Stock Put Long. It is a supplied numeric zero, not a missing cell.
limitations: Single day cannot establish rolling participation history or current feed health.
Embedded source_file is a provenance claim; original exchange fetch/authenticity was not verified.
All 5 peer differences are date serialization, with every other field exactly equal. Keep both source contexts.

review.meaning: Six annual coverage summaries for a named Q1 FII 20D ranking study. It is not a ranked signal table and contains no return, trade or outcome observations.

units.observations: count of observations, selection and grain unspecified
units.avg_rankable_symbols: reported average symbol count; weighting/denominator unspecified

observations: Year key is unique and increasing, all count fields are positive integers, and all six average counts are at most the within-year unique counts.

observations/rankable_dates ranges from 9.2727 to 15.8776, while avg_rankable_symbols ranges from 51.9706 to 84.1301. These are not the same statistic. The difference is a definition gap, not sufficient proof of an arithmetic error.
Annual unique_scrips sum is 829 but cannot be interpreted as 829 unique scrips across the study because cross-year identity overlap is absent.
limitations: Raw ranked observations, date-level universe sizes, IDs, ranking recipe, missingness policy and generator are absent from the selected file.
No source formula can be recalculated from this summary.
No counterpart in the three scoped peer packs was identified; no archive-wide absence claim is made.
Filename 20D does not prove 20 trading sessions. The separate current Q1 join script uses a different input file.
review.proposed_usage: Historical coverage note with unresolved definitions; do not use to prove sample representativeness, backtest returns or live availability.

review.meaning: Stored 12-by-12 signal correlation matrix; identical signal row/column order and no missing numeric entries.

window.peer_context: Previously reviewed IFR cash evidence uses 3315 joined dates from 2007-01-08 to 2022-12-08; association is supported by exact labels and all values matching within rounding, not by dates embedded here.

units.correlation: Dimensionless coefficient in [-1,1]; not return or probability.

observations: All diagonal entries are 1, symmetry error is 0, all values are finite and in range, and minimum eigenvalue is positive (about 0.0143347). These establish matrix consistency only.

Seven off-diagonal pairs are at least 0.8, including IFR_FII_STRICT / IFR_FII_DIV at 0.981841319 and FII_DII_DIV / FII_ANY at 0.921962411. The table supports concern about overlap among named signals, not independence.
All 144 numeric fields differ lexically from the peer because of serialization/precision; maximum numerical difference is about 4.61e-10.
inherited_peer_limitations: Prior evidence recomputed an 11-signal/121-cell submatrix but left STRUCT_FRACTURE definition unresolved. This pass did not rerun underlying daily-signal generation.
The peer's thresholds use retrospective full-sample calibration; coefficient reproduction is not point-in-time predictive validation.
limitations: Correlation method, estimator, date filters, handling of missing signal values and population are not specified in this CSV.
FII_DII_DIV here corresponds by peer context to FII_DII_DIVERGENCE in the distribution table; this is a contextual alias, not an automatic schema merge.
ADAPTIVE_STACK_TRIGGER appears in the distribution table but is absent from this matrix.
The provided coefficient table cannot reproduce the underlying signal sequence.
review.proposed_usage: Historical signal-overlap reference with peer lineage and retained unresolved definition.

review.meaning: Fourteen stored distribution summaries: FIRED and NOT_FIRED groups for seven signals.

window.peer_context: The matching IFR peer evidence describes the next 15 retained joined-row returns, not verified consecutive exchange sessions. Full windows span 21-103 calendar days; 15 incomplete end windows remain populated, final value zero.

units.mean_median_quantiles: Return percentage points. A stored -0.842610038 means -0.842610038 percent, not -84.2610038 percent.
units.negative_fwd15_pct: Percentage of group observations with negative stored forward return, 0-100 scale.

observations: Every FIRED/NOT_FIRED pair sums to 3315; these seven pairs reuse one population, so counts should not be summed into seven independent samples.
All ordered quantiles satisfy p05 <= p25 <= median <= p75 <= p95.
All seven weighted means agree at about 1.145622295 percent; integer reconstruction of negative rates yields 1279 negative stored forward labels for each paired population.
FII_Q10 FIRED has higher mean forward return than NOT_FIRED (difference +0.823553067 percentage points); six other FIRED groups have lower means. This is descriptive, not a causal signal claim.

IFR_DAMAGE and IFR_FII_STRICT fired-group means are negative but their medians are positive. All seven fired-group negative-return rates are below 50 percent, so negative mean does not mean most fired observations fell.
All labels/counts match peer; 98 numeric fields differ only within rounding, maximum difference about 4.96e-9.
inherited_peer_limitations: The 2026-09-24 evidence reproduced all 14 summaries from the exported forward values, including truncated tail windows.
Joined-date omissions, retrospective threshold calibration, overlapping horizons and incomplete tails limit any predictive or investable interpretation.
limitations: No underlying dated outcome rows or calculation formulas in this CSV.
No confidence intervals, cost/slippage model, independence adjustment or held-out evaluation supplied.
The full daily-series reproduction was inherited from accepted peer evidence and not rerun in this bounded six-file audit.
review.proposed_usage: Historical descriptive return-distribution reference, with the incomplete-horizon limitation attached.

review.meaning: Fifteen selected combinations of two threshold conditions, ordered by reported lift.

window.peer_context: Reviewed IFR research evidence has 7162 market-internal rows from 1996-01-02 through 2024-07-05 and full-sample quantile calibration.

units.fires: Count of observations meeting both conditions; unique event count is not specified.
units.threshold_percent_sign: Percentile shorthand in the trigger label; not proof of an absolute 90 percent return threshold.

observations: All 15 rows independently reconstruct integer TP, precision=TP/fires, recall=TP/755 and lift=(TP/fires)/(755/7162) within 5.1e-10.
The leading combination has 6 implied true positives among 21 fires, precision 28.5714286 percent, recall 0.794702 percent and lift 2.710312204.
Selection by highest observed lift can favor small samples; no independent current-performance conclusion follows.
All labels and counts match the peer; 44 numeric strings differ, maximum numeric difference about 5e-10.
limitations: Only top combinations are retained; tested candidate count, multiple-testing controls, calibration split, dated fires, forward label and exact prediction horizon are absent.
Percentile cutoffs need their calibration population and precise numeric thresholds before reproduction.
The two-condition AND text does not establish executable runtime signal logic.
review.proposed_usage: Historical candidate research and regression reference only.

review.meaning: Twenty selected single-condition pre-fall threshold results, ordered by reported lift.

window.peer_context: Matching IFR peer and previously reviewed market internals; context is historical, with full-sample quantile calibration.

units.fires: Count of firing observations, not proven independent market events.
units.lift: Dimensionless precision divided by the implied positive-label rate.
units.parenthesized_thresholds: Rounded numeric cutoffs in feature-native units. Return-feature examples use decimal returns; do not use display-rounded cutoffs as exact original thresholds.

observations: All 20 rows independently reconstruct integer TP, precision=TP/fires, recall=TP/755 and lift=(TP/fires)/(755/7162) within 5.1e-10.
The highest-lift single condition implies 86 true positives among 358 fires, 24.0223464 percent precision and 11.3907285 percent recall.
Precision spans 14.1061453-24.0223464 percent. Lift above one is relative to the roughly 10.5417 percent positive base rate; it is not high absolute prediction accuracy.
tail_up3_5d > 90pct and dbi_5d < 10pct have identical metric tuples but different trigger definitions. Do not deduplicate on metrics alone.
All labels and counts match the peer; 60 numeric strings differ only within rounding, maximum difference about 4.89e-10.
limitations: Prediction label, forecast horizon, event independence, date range and sample exclusions are not embedded.
Yield-change trigger has 99 fires; eligible yield-history denominator is not shown. The algebraically common full-sample base rate does not establish feature-specific eligibility.
All source cells are values; thresholds and label generation cannot be independently regenerated from these summary rows alone.
review.proposed_usage: Historical threshold-candidate reference with low absolute precision and unresolved label/window definitions.

cross_file_checks.duplicate_policy: Five peer correspondences have equal labels/order/counts with date format or numeric rounding changes. Preserve AM07 member hashes and archive provenance. No automatic duplicate reuse, merge, deletion, second-sample counting or source-authority promotion.
cross_file_checks.no_new_independent_samples: Repeated summaries in AM07 do not add independent evidence to previously reviewed IFR/participant research.
cross_file_checks.dissimilar_populations: 3315 IFR cash joined rows, 7162 trigger-research rows, Q1 annual coverage counts and a one-day participant snapshot are distinct populations. Do not join/average them by filename similarity.

trigger_denominator_reconstruction.scope_limit: An algebraic consistency check. Does not recover label definitions, calibration dates, event independence or source feature generation.

forward_population_reconstruction.scope_limit: Consistency of reported group summaries; medians/quantiles cannot be independently recomputed without dated individual outcomes.

files.finding: Wrapper applies data intelligence and intelligence score patches in the local server construction.
Six hardcoded trigger summary rows. It does not read either CSV dynamically; four pre-fall and two combo rows match source metrics rounded to four decimals.

/api/data-intelligence payload presents an arithmetic average of six stored lifts and uses the label validated_triggers with a current response timestamp; timestamp does not update historical research.
regimeRiskScore uses average static lift * 10 for every row, without evaluating current source conditions.
regime risk contributes to intelligence score and SELECT_READY/WATCH_READY/RISK_REVIEW logic in the paper scoring patch. This is a local code-consumer finding, not production behavior verification.
Lists signal_forward_return_distribution.csv as an event-validation source with PAPER_PROOF_PARTIAL; declaration does not demonstrate ingestion.
Displays trigger rows and average Trigger Lift from the payload; does not recompute historical research.
Consumes Q1_FII_20D_ranked_top_bottom_deciles_READY_FOR_PRICE_JOIN.csv, not this annual summary file. Source search found no direct consumer for the scoped Q1 stats filename.

current_consumers.exact_name_search_scope: Repository text source and docs searched, excluding data evidence dumps for consumer classification; no direct loader identified for scoped participant snapshot, correlation matrix or Q1 year stats.
current_consumers.defect_review_only: The existing static historical lift contribution must not be interpreted as a current trigger computation. No correction, score change or activation was made.

limits: Content status reviewed means full reading and explicit checks, not complete scientific validation, approved authority, currentness or runtime readiness.
The six CSVs have no executable formulas; inferred metric identities are recorded separately from source definitions.
Source-generator code, full exchange calendars, point-in-time instrument identity, survivorship, corporate-action adjustment, costs and out-of-sample validity were not established.
Prior evidence supplies some context and reproducibility limits; only the explicitly listed summary and peer comparisons were freshly recomputed.
No source files changed, no provider/network/Render/database access, no runtime or archive code execution, no trade/order activity, no overlay/plan changes and no Git commit/push/publication.
review_gate: Eligible for historical source review with these limitations retained. Any future runtime integration or research correction is separate work.
